name: one-c-erp-diagnostics
description: Dynamic evidence-first orchestration for 1C:ERP diagnostics, code analysis and controlled remediation.

interface.longDescription: A single dynamic orchestrator for 1C:ERP incidents. It discovers available capabilities, builds an evidence graph, routes specialist skills, uses optional companion plugins only when available, challenges conclusions adversarially, and controls every proposed action through reversible risk gates.
defaultPrompt: Сравни корректный и проблемный примеры 1С:ERP и перепроверь причину.
